evidence.q: Below-Measure whispered, “His fear makes him weak; keep everything.” But Mira’s silver bell answered, “Small trust is still trust. Let its fair echo return.”

"But what if the far shore is a stranger?"

"Then begin with a portion, and let the seasons speak. Strangers are not enemies; they are simply unread ledgers. Send enough to let them show you who they are, and answer what they show."

"Why trust one you have never met?" asked his grandson.

"Because trust is the only seed that makes the field," Tavi said. "If I give little, I teach her to give little. If I give all, I show her the path."
Reed asked whether wisdom required trust. Thria shook her head.
